Tags, attachments, orphans, unresolved links and a color group are on; Pixi draws them on a canvas with the colors Obsidian reads from .graph-view.color-* probes. evidence.record holds the colors the renderer read from each probe class and how many screenshot pixels have exactly that color.

Help window: each help link row starts with a .setting-icon.

Captured by `capture:run --no-pointer`: the app runs headless without the mouse setting, so Blink itself reports (hover: none) and (pointer: none). DevTools media emulation cannot change hover or pointer in this Chromium.

Debug view, not the export: Obsidian's testPrint() lays the print layout (body > .print) into the dark main window, with @media print emulated. Real Export to PDF renders in its own window with body.theme-light: see qc.print.export-window.
